name: Bases Manual Order
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds manual row ordering with numeric note ranks and separate Pro orderings.
Adds table and list row ordering with saved numeric ranks.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Drag a row or use its move buttons to set an order that stays, saved as a number in each note.
Pro can keep a separate order for each view in its own number property.
tip: To show the same order in a core Bases table, sort that table ascending by manual_order.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Manual Order is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for putting your notes in order with it.
